long_description:
Duck! Bubbles! All Done! is a talk-along bath book for ages 0–2, made for the minutes you already spend together in the tub. Each of its six pages shows one big bath-time word: splash, pour, bubbles, duck, wash and all done. The word sits in huge rounded letters above one bold, simple picture on a bright, high-contrast page.

Under every picture is one short grown-up tip. Say it as you do it, pause before you pour, offer a choice, copy their sounds, name each body part as you wash, then sign and say all done. A look, a sound or a splash counts as your little one's turn. There is nothing to get right.

The back cover repeats the bath rule that matters most: stay within arm's reach every second. The book is for talk and play, not a float or a seat.

This is a design preview. The book is not for sale yet. A bath book has to be made in a factory run and safety-tested by an independent lab before anyone can buy it, and we will only take orders once that is done. Talk, sign, sing and read in the language you know best.

faq.q: Can I buy this bath book?
faq.a: Not yet. This is a design preview. A bath book is made in a factory run and has to pass independent safety testing before anyone can buy it. We will only take orders once that is done.

faq.q: Why can't you print it on demand like your paperbacks?
faq.a: Printers that make one book at a time don't make sealed, waterproof bath books. It needs a factory run, lab testing and a warehouse, so it waits until we can do all of that properly.
Ages 0–2, with a grown-up within arm's reach the whole time. Babies look and splash; toddlers start to copy the words and the all-done sign.
Six bath-time words, one per page: splash, pour, bubbles, duck, wash and all done. Each page has one big picture and one short grown-up tip.

faq.q: Is it safe to leave my child with it in the bath?
faq.a: Never leave a child alone in or near water, with or without a book. The book is for talk and play together, not a float or a seat.
Squeeze out the water, wipe it dry and stand it open to dry after each bath. Check every page before each bath, and stop using it if anything splits or peels.

faq.q: Will it teach my baby to talk?
faq.a: It's a book for talking and playing together. We don't promise any result; every child talks on their own timeline. If you have questions about your child's talking, your child's doctor is a good place to start.

faq.q: We speak another language at home. Does it still work?
faq.a: Yes. Talk, sign, sing and read in the language you know best. Say each word in your home language.

faq.q: How will I know when it's available?
faq.a: Join the free email list at playbeforepixels.com. We'll only announce it once testing is done and a ship date is real.
